W.note: A slim 300px bar opens with a smooth grid transition into a dense but readable card showing stages, timeline, ETA, carrier, tracking number, next-step advice, and copy/open/dismiss, with aria-expanded and inert body handling.

X.note: It rests fully expanded as a tall multi-package list that covers much of a phone screen, the collapse snaps with no transition, and the chevrons are tiny glyphs, though the per-package toggles are real buttons.

Y.note: The panel rests fully expanded with a form and three packages, collapse is an abrupt snap, the per-package timeline opens from a non-focusable div so it is not keyboard reachable, and tracking numbers are cut to their last six digits.

Z.note: The 232px pill rotates its chevron through a timed grid expansion into a clean checkpoint trail with status-tinted accents, action advice, copy/open/dismiss, labeled controls and reduced-motion handling, with only the ETA truncated in the header.
